firmware.name: TouchBloop
firmware.author: Synthux Academy
firmware.description: Glitch looper: touch a pad to grab the input and loop it back through that pad's distortion.
firmware.notes:
## TouchBloop
Source and binary: [Synthux-Academy/TouchBloop](https://github.com/Synthux-Academy/TouchBloop).

## Quick start
Turn **S35 (Mix)** all the way up, play something into the input and touch a pad. The loop replaces the input while it plays. Sound has to be coming in when you touch.

## Pads
- **P03–P09** · hold to loop, each with its own distortion; **P05** (centre) is clean
- **P03 / P04 / P08** · wah low / mid / high, with bit crush
- **P06 / P07 / P09** · fold light / medium / heavy
- Hold several pads: the loop keeps going and the last pad touched sets the distortion
- **P10 (TO) or P11 (CH)** · hold for the knobs' hidden functions
- **P00–P02** · not used

## Hidden functions (hold TO or CH)
- **S32** · pitch snaps to fifths and octaves
- **S33** · tape flutter
- **S34** · reverb time
- **S35** · output volume
- **S37** · input volume, up to +12 dB

A hidden function takes over only once the knob passes where it was last set, so nothing jumps.

## Switches
- **S07-S08 (pads)** · up latch, centre momentary, down effects only (no loops)
- **S09-S10 (direction)** · forward, random or reverse per pass

## LED
Blinks on every new pass of the loop.
